environment.description: Same application deployed on Windows Server 2022 IIS. The SQL Server connection uses a dedicated login 'app_corpsearch_ro' mapped to a database user with a custom role 'role_audit_reader' that has been granted only SELECT permission on the Departments table and EXECUTE on a stored procedure sp_GetDepartments. The user has no permissions on SearchAuditLog table (neither SELECT nor INSERT). The LDAP service account used in the DirectoryEntry binding has had its Active Directory permissions scoped via a delegated OU-level ACE that restricts the account to read-only access on the 'OU=Employees,DC=corp,DC=internal' subtree only, with Deny ACE on Read for all other OUs including OU=ServiceAccounts and OU=Admins. Additionally, the IIS Application Pool identity runs under a gMSA that has no network logon rights beyond the specific LDAP port to dc01.

config.db_role: role_audit_reader (SELECT on Departments only, no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on any table)
config.ldap_service_account_scope: Read-only delegated ACE on OU=Employees only, explicit Deny on OU=ServiceAccounts, OU=Admins, OU=Domain Controllers
config.gmsa_network_restriction: Firewall rule allows outbound only to dc01:389, SQL:1433
